Class B1Block

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.btf.ComponentBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks.TopLevelBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks.B1Block
public class B1Block extends TopLevelBlock
This class implements the B1 Block of the B matrix. The Factory Methods newMacroBlock and subBlockCopy are implemented to return the correct block type in the parallel hierarchy. Type 1 Macro Blocks are selected for lower class linear systems
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
